Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal representation by returning a buffer sharing non-public data (MS_EXPOSE_BUF)
Bug_Details:
A public static method either returns a buffer (java.nio.*Buffer) which wraps an array that is part of the
static state of the class by holding a reference only to this same array or it returns a shallow-copy of a buffer
that is part of the static stat of the class which shares its reference with the original buffer.
 Any code that calls this method can freely modify the underlying array.
 One fix is to return a read-only buffer or a new buffer with a copy of the array.
Bug_Explanation: This bug is present in the `showBug` method. It returns a buffer that shares non-public data with the static state of the class. Any code that calls this method can modify the underlying array.
Trigger_Explanation: By calling the 'put' method on the ByteBuffer returned by the'showBug' method, we are trying to modify the underlying array. Since the ByteBuffer is backed by the original 'buffer' array and it is of the same size, if the ByteBuffer is changed to a read-only buffer or a new buffer with its own copy of the array, the test would not fail and the bug would be exposed.
